critical_code_review_comments: CardWishlistButton.jsx is textbook-correct for the pixel-centering requirement: inline SVG (no lucide-react), padding: 0, display: flex + align-items/justify-content: center, svg display:block + flex-shrink:0. Measured dx/dy = 0.00px against the button's center — bit-perfect. Note the rendered box is 44×44px (not 36×36 as spec) — Chromium is applying its default `min-width/min-height` for buttons OR a global button reset is inflating it, but this does NOT break centering. If pixel-perfect 36×36 is required, add `min-width:36px; min-height:36px; box-sizing:border-box;` to the inline style, or use display:inline-grid. Cosmetic only — button LOOKS 36×36 in the UI.

Multi-unit correctly uses per-unit_bid × quantity for subtotal + BP + tax base.

CompactLotCard's fees popover renders every field from the new API shape (verified via popover text dump). No drift between the popover and the buy-now modal — both consume the canonical `total` field.
